answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before its votes or offers count, then slash the stake when independent checks confirm it broke a delivery commitment. A prism of evaluators can compare receipts, and a public beacon lets others audit the evidence. A sybil attacker must fund every identity and risks losing each stake, so multiplying accounts to sway outcomes has a direct, measurable cost. This raises the price of influence without claiming to make fake identities impossible, even near the zenith of coordinated activity.
